item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 4:56 AM, 25 November 2026(Wednesday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bataan (Orion, Bagac, Pilar, and Balanga), Batangas (Tuy, Lian, Talisay, Laurel, Balayan, Tanauan, Santo Tomas, and Calaca), Bulacan (Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray, and San Jose del Monte), Laguna (Santa Rosa, Cabuyao, Calamba, Santa Cruz, Pagsanjan, Luisiana, Majayjay, Magdalena, Pila, Liliw, Nagcarlan, Victoria, Los Banos, Alaminos, Bay, Calauan, Rizal, and San Pablo), Metro Manila (Caloocan, Malabon, Navotas, Valenzuela, Quezon City, Taguig, Makati, Mandaluyong, Pasig, San Juan, Pasay, Pateros, Marikina, and Manila), Nueva Ecija (General Tinio), Quezon (Sampaloc, Mauban, Atimonan, Gumaca, Plaridel, Lopez, Buenavista, Lucban, Catanauan, General Luna, Macalelon, Mulanay, San Narciso, Pitogo, and Unisan), and Rizal (Taytay, Cainta, San Mateo, Angono, Baras, Morong, and Teresa) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Bataan (Mariveles and Limay), Batangas (Nasugbu), Laguna (Santa Maria, Siniloan, Famy, Pangil, San Pedro, Binan, Kalayaan, Paete, Pakil, Lumban, Cavinti, and Mabitac), Metro Manila (Las Pinas, Muntinlupa, and Paranaque), Quezon (General Nakar, Real, Infanta, Perez, Quezon, Alabat, Calauag, Guinayangan, Tagkawayan, Polillo, Patnanungan, Jomalig, Panukulan, and Burdeos), Rizal (Tanay, Rodriguez, Antipolo, Pililla, Jala-Jala, Cardona, and Binangonan), and Cavite which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
